_comment: Example only: copy to config.json and put in your own values. Every part is optional: delete any id or host you don't know, or the whole lights block, and the lights are found by SSDP discovery (by model). A configured id that isn't found is never replaced by another device. host is only a starting IP (discovered IPs are cached in ip-cache.json). location (decimal degrees, north and east positive) is needed only by daylight.js; 51.48, 0.0 is Greenwich.
